summary: Okeanis Eco Tankers Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting mandatory notifications of trade under EU MAR article 19. A fund managed by QVT Financial LP, closely associated with board member Daniel Gold, sold 76,959 ordinary shares on August 13-14, 2026, at USD 65.04 and USD 59.99 per share, reducing QVT's holdings to 1,347,038 shares. The filing is purely a routine insider-trade disclosure and does not constitute a special situation. It provides no transaction terms, board recommendation, advisors, or strategic intent. The notification is routine regulatory compliance; no special-situation analysis or risk-arb angle applies.
